context.body: Preparation, table, and the approaching death
context.label: Event location

observations.body: Two disciples enter the city, follow a man with water, find a furnished room, and prepare.
observations.label: Route

observations.body: One-of-you language, sorrowful questions, dipping, written destiny, and woe precede bread and cup.
observations.label: Table speech

observations.body: All drink, future kingdom is named, a hymn is sung, and the group leaves for the Mount of Olives.
observations.label: Closing

payload.tension: Detailed preparation gives way to a meal where intimate sharing and predicted betrayal remain adjacent.
payload.title: Two disciples find the room before the Twelve eat
